versos.grego: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν Θεοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τῆς ἐλπίδος ἡμῶν

controles.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and Christ Jesus our hope;
controles.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
controles.livre: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus segundo o mandado de Deus, nosso Salvador, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nossa esperança.

versos.grego: Τιμοθέῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ ἐν πίστει· χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.

controles.web: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
controles.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
controles.livre: Para Timóteo, meu verdadeiro filho na fé. Graça, misericórdia e paz da parte de Deus Pai, e de Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.

versos.grego: Καθὼς παρεκάλεσά σε προσμεῖναι ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, πορευόμενος εἰς Μακεδονίαν, ἵνα παραγγείλῃς τισὶν μὴ ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖν

controles.web: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
controles.kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
controles.livre: Assim como te roguei quando eu estava indo à Macedônia, fica em Éfeso, para advertires a alguns que não ensinem outra doutrina,

versos.grego: μηδὲ προσέχειν μύθοις καὶ γενεαλογίαις ἀπεράντοις, αἵτινες ἐκζητήσεις παρέχουσιν μᾶλλον ἢ οἰκονομίαν Θεοῦ τὴν ἐν πίστει·

controles.web: neither to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith—
controles.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
controles.livre: Nem prestem atenção a mitos nem a genealogias intermináveis, que mais produzem discussões que a administração  da parte de Deus na fé.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ τέλος τῆς παραγγελίας ἐστὶν ἀγάπη ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας καὶ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς καὶ πίστεως ἀνυποκρίτου,

controles.web: but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith;
controles.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
controles.livre: O fim do mandamento é o amor que vem de um coração puro, e de uma boa consciência, e de uma fé não fingida.

versos.grego: ὧν τινες ἀστοχήσαντες ἐξετράπησαν εἰς ματαιολογίαν,

controles.web: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned aside to vain talking;
controles.kjv: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
controles.livre: Alguns se desviaram dessas coisas, e se entregaram a discursos inúteis;

versos.grego: θέλοντες εἶναι νομοδιδάσκαλοι, μὴ νοοῦντες μήτε ἃ λέγουσιν μήτε περὶ τίνων διαβεβαιοῦνται.

controles.web: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.
controles.kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
controles.livre: querendo ser mestres da Lei, mas não entendendo, nem o que dizem, nem o que afirmam.

versos.grego: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι καλὸς ὁ νόμος, ἐάν τις αὐτῷ νομίμως χρῆται,

controles.web: But we know that the law is good, if a man uses it lawfully,
controles.kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
controles.livre: Nós, porém, sabemos que a Lei é boa, se alguém usa dela legitimamente;

versos.grego: εἰδὼς τοῦτο, ὅτι δικαίῳ νόμος οὐ κεῖται, ἀνόμοις δὲ καὶ ἀνυποτάκτοις, ἀσεβέσι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοῖς, ἀνοσίοις καὶ βεβήλοις, πατρολῴαις καὶ μητρολῴαις, ἀνδροφόνοις,

controles.web: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for man slayers,
controles.kjv: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
controles.livre: pois sabemos isto: que a Lei não foi feita para o justo, mas sim, para os injustos e insubordinados, para os ímpios e pecadores, para os irreligiosos e profanos, para os matadores dos pais e das mães, para os homicidas,

versos.grego: πόρνοις, ἀρσενοκοίταις, ἀνδραποδισταῖς, ψεύσταις, ἐπιόρκοις, καὶ εἴ τι ἕτερον τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀντίκειται,

controles.web: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;
controles.kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
controles.livre: para os que cometem pecados sexuais, para os homens que efetuam sexualidade com homens, para os que roubam a liberdade das pessoas,  para os mentirosos, para os que juram falsamente, e qualquer outra coisa contrária à sã doutrina,

versos.grego: κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ μακαρίου Θεοῦ, ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγώ.

controles.web: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
controles.kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
controles.livre: conforme o evangelho da glória do Deus bendito,  que foi confiado a mim.

versos.grego: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ ἐνδυναμώσαντί με Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν, ὅτι πιστόν με ἡγήσατο θέμενος εἰς διακονίαν,

controles.web: And I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;
controles.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
controles.livre: Agradeço àquele que tem me fortalecido, Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor, porque me considerou fiel, pondo-me no serviço.

versos.grego: τὸ πρότερον ὄντα βλάσφημον καὶ διώκτην καὶ ὑβριστήν· ἀλλὰ ἠλεήθην, ὅτι ἀγνοῶν ἐποίησα ἐν ἀπιστίᾳ,

controles.web: although I was before a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
controles.kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
controles.livre: Antes eu era um blasfemo, perseguidor, e opressor; porém recebi misericórdia, pois foi por ignorância que eu agia com incredulidade.

versos.grego: ὑπερεπλεόνασεν δὲ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν μετὰ πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Mas a graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo foi mais abundante, com a fé e amor que há em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος, ὅτι Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἁμαρτωλοὺς σῶσαι· ὧν πρῶτός εἰμι ἐγώ·

controles.web: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
controles.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
controles.livre: Esta é uma palavra fiel e digna de toda aceitação: que Cristo Jesus veio ao mundo para salvar os pecadores, dos quais eu sou o principal.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἠλεήθην, ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ πρώτῳ ἐνδείξηται Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς τὴν ἅπασαν μακροθυμίαν, πρὸς ὑποτύπωσιν τῶν μελλόντων πιστεύειν ἐπ’ αὐτῷ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience, for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
controles.kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
controles.livre: Mas por isso me foi concedida misericórdia, para que em mim, o principal, Jesus Cristo mostrasse toda a sua paciência como exemplo aos que haviam de crer nele para a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Τῷ δὲ Βασιλεῖ τῶν αἰώνων, ἀφθάρτῳ ἀοράτῳ μόνῳ Θεῷ, τιμὴ καὶ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

controles.web: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
controles.kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
controles.livre: Ao Rei dos tempos, imortal, invisível, o único Deus,seja a honra, e a glória, para todo o sempre, amém!

versos.grego: Ταύτην τὴν παραγγελίαν παρατίθεμαί σοι, τέκνον Τιμόθεε, κατὰ τὰς προαγούσας ἐπὶ σὲ προφητείας, ἵνα στρατεύῃ ἐν αὐταῖς τὴν καλὴν στρατείαν,

controles.web: This instruction I commit to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to you, that by them you may wage the good warfare;
controles.kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
controles.livre: Este mandamento, filho Timóteo, te dou: que, conforme as profecias antes feitas acerca de ti, que batalhes por elas a boa batalha;

versos.grego: ἔχων πίστιν καὶ ἀγαθὴν συνείδησιν, ἥν τινες ἀπωσάμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἐναυάγησαν·

controles.web: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith;
controles.kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
controles.livre: mantendo a fé e a boa consciência, que alguns rejeitaram, e naufragaram na fé.

versos.grego: ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος, οὓς παρέδωκα τῷ Σατανᾷ, ἵνα παιδευθῶσιν μὴ βλασφημεῖν.

controles.web: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
controles.kjv: Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
controles.livre: Dentre esses foram Himeneu e Alexandre. Eu os entreguei a Satanás, para aprenderem a não blasfemar.
